name: Prestige Hair & Beauty
lead: A family-run South London salon for more than 10 years. Threading, lashes, facials, nails and hair, all done by highly trained specialists.

experience.title: Everyone is beautiful in their own way
experience.text: We celebrate diversity and inclusivity, with a team of warm and inviting specialists here for all of your beauty needs. From a simple, subtle manicure to a glamorous blow-dry, we've got you covered, so you leave feeling Prestige.

currency_note: Prices for the 22 London Road branch. Also in Thornton Heath and Kingston.

special.title: Family-run, South London proud
special.text: For more than 10 years we've been a trusted choice in the South London community, now in Croydon, Thornton Heath and Kingston, with the latest technology and highly specialised staff.

reviews: Finding a salon that nails every service is rare, but Prestige Hair and Beauty in West Croydon is officially my new go-to! I visited recently for a full "glow up"—nails, lashes, and henna brows—and I couldn't be happier with the 5-star experience. Nails: My nail technician was a perfectionist.

Absolutely love my eyebrows every single time 🤍 Ankush at Prestige Beauty is the only person I trust with my brows! She did my henna brows with an ombré style and they came out perfect. She’s so patient, takes her time, and really perfects her work down to every detail.

Prestige beauty & nails is far one of the best salon I have visited from the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with reception people salon is beautifully maintained spotless has a relaxing atmosphere. Team is incredibly talented and knowledgeable.

"I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Prestige Hair, Beauty & Nails! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by a warm and professional team who made me feel completely relaxed. The salon is spotlessly clean, and they truly pay attention to every detail.
